properties_numbers.name: properties_numbers
properties_numbers.value: ("properties"."price" is null or "properties"."price" >= 0) and ("properties"."area" is null or "properties"."area" >= 0) and ("properties"."bedrooms" is null or "properties"."bedrooms" >= 0) and ("properties"."bathrooms" is null or "properties"."bathrooms" >= 0)

vehicles_numbers.name: vehicles_numbers
vehicles_numbers.value: "vehicles"."year" between 1886 and 2200 and ("vehicles"."price" is null or "vehicles"."price" >= 0) and ("vehicles"."mileage" is null or "vehicles"."mileage" >= 0)

appointments_target.name: appointments_target
appointments_target.value: ("appointments"."kind" = 'property_visit' and "appointments"."property_id" is not null and "appointments"."vehicle_id" is null) or ("appointments"."kind" = 'test_drive' and "appointments"."vehicle_id" is not null and "appointments"."property_id" is null)

ai_request_nonnegative.name: ai_request_nonnegative
ai_request_nonnegative.value: "ai_requests"."quota_limit" >= 0 and ("ai_requests"."input_tokens" is null or "ai_requests"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("ai_requests"."output_tokens" is null or "ai_requests"."output_tokens" >= 0)
